label: Rule-54 glider-route gate
title: Can a one-site rule hold recover a published Rule-54 route?
summary: For an independently sourced Rule-54 junction-pair seed, a full-state single-site held update at time two recovers 68 of 1,156 injured trajectories beyond passive and fixed controls; all first rejoin the clean route at time seven.
takeaway: Dynamic repair is feasible under this frozen contract, but holding a known injury address matches the full-state bound. No G sensor or autonomous controller was tested.
